questions.question: Which service is a regional layer-7 web load balancer with URL-based routing and an optional Web Application Firewall?
questions.explanation: Application Gateway works at layer 7 within a region.

questions.question: Users worldwide should be routed to the nearest healthy region of a web app. Which service fits best?
questions.explanation: Front Door is a global layer-7 entry point.

questions.question: Which service distributes TCP and UDP traffic across VMs within a region?
questions.explanation: Azure Load Balancer operates at layer 4.
